title: Reduce, reuse, recycle: how dbt State cut rebuilds by 92% at RxBenefits
description:
How RxBenefits cut dbt model rebuilds 92% and warehouse costs 59% with dbt State, using real dbt Cost Insights numbers. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Chris Shepherd (principal data engineer) and Andrew Coleman (staff analytics engineer) at RxBenefits go inside the dbt Cost Insights dashboards behind their results. dbt State lets each model be skipped, zero-copy cloned, or rebuilt individually. Over a 60-day production window, RxBenefits cut warehouse costs 59% and reused more than 716,000 models instead of rebuilding them. They also cover dbt State limits to audit first, such as models built on select * that rebuild every time.

In this session you'll learn:
• How dbt State decides to skip, clone, or rebuild a model
• What 60 days of dbt Cost Insights data shows
• Which patterns limit reuse and how to find them

Speakers: Chris Shepherd and Andrew Coleman, RxBenefits

Read more: With dbt State, stop rebuilding what didn't change. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/dbt-state-is-ga
